server.title: 1. ServerTools (`server` family — Connection, Discovery, Undo/Redo, UI Actions & Logging)

model.title: 2. ModelTools (`model` family — Projects, Elements, Stereotypes, Properties, Relationships & State Semantics)

diagrams.title: 3. DiagramTools (`diagrams` family — Diagram Lifecycle, Symbols, Paths, Layout, Compartments & Export)

artifacts.title: 4. ArtifactTools (`artifacts` family — Generic Tables, Dependency Matrices, Relation Maps, Reports, XMI, Attachments & Snapshots)

advanced.title: 5. AdvancedTools (`advanced` family — Macros, OCL/Expressions, Validation, Profiles, Smart Packages, Hyperlinks, Diff/Merge & Teamwork Cloud)

analysis.title: 6. AnalysisTools (`analysis` family — Simulation Toolkit, Parametrics, Traceability, Impact/Coverage, Metrics, Trade Studies, Roll-Ups, OOSEM & Semantic Verification)

sysml2.title: 7. Sysml2Tools (`sysml2` family — Cameo 2026x SysML v2 / KerML Textual Notation, Usages, Definitions, Data Markings & v1↔v2 Conversion)

tools.name: cameo_status
tools.description: Check that Cameo and the MCP plugin are up. Returns plugin version, Cameo product/version, endpoint and port, connected clients, whether a project is open, and recent errors. Call this first in every session.

tools.name: cameo_get_capabilities
tools.description: Machine-readable capability report: tool families and counts, which optional Cameo plugins (Dependency Matrix, Generic Table, Relation Map, Simulation, Teamwork, Report Wizard, DataHub, SysML v2) are present, whether macros are allowed, and supported MCP protocol versions.

tools.name: cameo_probe_bridge
tools.description: Self-test of the MCP connection from inside Cameo: checks the HTTP endpoint answers /status and /health paths, bound port and host, Swing EDT responsiveness, and SessionManager editing-session state.

tools.name: cameo_list_tools
tools.description: Search this server's tool catalog by family (server, model, diagrams, artifacts, advanced, analysis, sysml2) and/or keyword. Returns name, family, kind (read/write/destructive) and summary description.

tools.name: cameo_list_families
tools.description: Summarize all 7 catalog tool families (server, model, diagrams, artifacts, advanced, analysis, sysml2) and their tool counts.

tools.name: cameo_list_prompts
tools.description: List pre-configured MCP workflow prompts registered in CatalogPrompts (model_system_structure, trace_requirements, review_model_quality, build_state_machine).

tools.name: cameo_get_last_error
tools.description: Return the stack trace and context of the latest plugin or OpenAPI execution exception.

tools.name: cameo_reset_session
tools.description: Recovery: cancel (roll back) a Cameo SessionManager editing session left open by a failed macro or interrupted write, so new writes can proceed.

tools.name: cameo_undo
tools.description: Undo the most recent model change in Cameo via CommandHistory.undo() (same as Edit > Undo). Each MCP write tool is one undoable step.

tools.name: cameo_redo
tools.description: Redo the most recently undone model change via CommandHistory.redo() (same as Edit > Redo).

tools.name: cameo_log
tools.description: Write a message prefixed with [Cameo MCP] to Cameo's Notification window (GUILog) and md.log file so the engineer watching Cameo can follow what the agent is doing.

tools.name: cameo_get_command_history
tools.description: Inspect the Undo and Redo command stack names and depth in `project.getCommandHistory()`. [Retroactive OpenAPI Discovery]

tools.name: cameo_clear_command_history
tools.description: Clear the project undo/redo command history buffer to reclaim memory after massive batch operations. [Retroactive OpenAPI Discovery]

tools.name: cameo_batch_create_elements
tools.description: Create N elements and apply stereotypes/tagged values in a single atomic SessionManager transaction (eliminating N-roundtrip latency). [Retroactive OpenAPI Discovery]

operations.description: array<{tempId, type, name, parentId, stereotypes, taggedValues, documentation}> (required)

tools.name: cameo_batch_create_relationships
tools.description: Create N relationships in a single atomic SessionManager transaction (supporting tempId references from batch creation). [Retroactive OpenAPI Discovery]

relationships.description: array<{type, sourceId, targetId, ownerId, name, stereotypes}> (required)

tools.name: cameo_list_ui_actions
tools.description: Search registered Cameo menu, toolbar, and diagram `NMAction` IDs and names across `ActionsManager`. [Retroactive OpenAPI Discovery]

tools.name: cameo_invoke_ui_action
tools.description: Invoke a registered Cameo `NMAction` by action ID on the Swing EDT (with safety blocklist against modal blocking dialogs). [Retroactive OpenAPI Discovery]

tools.name: cameo_select_in_containment_tree
tools.description: Expand and highlight one or more elements in the Cameo Containment Tree via `Browser.getContainmentTree().openNode(element, true)`. [Retroactive OpenAPI Discovery]

tools.name: cameo_write_gui_log
tools.description: Publish a plain-text or HTML clickable message to the Cameo Messages/Notification Log window via `Application.getInstance().getGUILog().log()` and `NotificationManager`. [Retroactive OpenAPI Discovery]

tools.name: cameo_get_project
tools.description: Get the open project: name, filePath, isRemote (Teamwork Cloud), isDirty (unsaved changes), projectKind, primaryModelId, and primaryModelName.

tools.name: cameo_save_project
tools.description: Save the open project to its existing location via ProjectsManager.saveProject (same as File > Save).

tools.name: cameo_get_ui_state
tools.description: Inspect the live Cameo UI: project, activeDiagram (id, name, type, owner), selectedElements (deduplicated union of diagram symbol selection and containment-tree selection), and active perspectives/views.

tools.name: cameo_get_active_diagram
tools.description: Get the diagram currently open and focused in Cameo as a compact payload: activeDiagram {id, name, type, owner} plus warnings.

tools.name: cameo_get_ui_selection
tools.description: Get what the user has selected: selectedElements (model elements), selectedPresentations (diagram symbols with presentationId), and browserSelection (containment tree node selection).

tools.name: cameo_query_elements
tools.description: Search model elements by metaclass, name, scope, and stereotype, sorted by type, name, id and paged.

tools.name: cameo_get_element
tools.description: Get full details of one element: id, type, humanType, name, qualifiedName, owner, stereotypes, documentation, taggedValues, type/multiplicity/aggregation for properties, target/source for relationships, diagrams inside, and child elements.

tools.name: cameo_get_containment_tree
tools.description: Nested containment tree (id, type, name, stereotypes, children) from a root down to depth levels; nodes at the depth limit report childCount.

tools.name: cameo_list_containment_children
tools.description: List the immediate children of one element, sorted by name and paged, with totalChildren, matchedChildren, hasMore, and nextOffset.

tools.name: cameo_create_element
tools.description: Create one model element under parentId and return it.

tools.name: cameo_create_elements
tools.description: Bulk-create many elements and relationships in ONE undoable SessionManager step, all-or-nothing.

tools.name: cameo_modify_element
tools.description: Rename an element and/or replace its documentation (first owned Comment, created if missing).

tools.name: cameo_move_element
tools.description: Move (reparent) an element to another owner via ModelElementsManager.moveElement, keeping its id, relationships, and diagram symbols.

tools.name: cameo_delete_element
tools.description: Permanently delete an element with everything it owns; relationships attached to it and its diagram symbols are removed cleanly.

tools.name: cameo_apply_stereotype
tools.description: Apply a stereotype to an element (e.g. block, requirement, valueType, testCase, rationale).

tools.name: cameo_remove_stereotype
tools.description: Unapply a stereotype from an element via StereotypesHelper.removeStereotype. Its tagged values are removed with it.

tools.name: cameo_set_tagged_values
tools.description: Set tagged values of a stereotype already applied to the element.

tools.name: cameo_set_stereotype_metaclasses
tools.description: Set the UML metaclasses a stereotype extends (its base classes) with Cameo's native API.

tools.name: cameo_apply_profile
tools.description: Apply a profile to a package or model so its stereotypes can be used inside it.

tools.name: cameo_create_relationship
tools.description: Create a relationship from sourceId to targetId (Association, DirectedAssociation, Composition, Generalization, Dependency, ControlFlow, ObjectFlow, Transition, Connector, InformationFlow, ItemFlow, Allocate, Satisfy, Derive, Refine, Trace, Verify, Include, Extend).

tools.name: cameo_get_element_relationships
tools.description: Find all relationships attached to an element, incoming, outgoing, or both (alias: cameo_get_relationships).

tools.name: cameo_reconnect_relationship
tools.description: Change the client (source) or supplier (target) end of an existing relationship without recreating it.

tools.name: cameo_delete_relationship
tools.description: Delete a relationship by id, leaving the connected elements intact.

tools.name: cameo_set_property_type
tools.description: Set or clear the classifier type of a Property, Port, FlowProperty, Pin, or ActivityParameterNode.

tools.name: cameo_set_property_multiplicity
tools.description: Set multiplicity lower/upper (e.g. '1', '0..1', '*', '1..*') on a Property, Port, FlowProperty, Pin, or ActivityParameterNode.

tools.name: cameo_set_property_default_value
tools.description: Set or clear the default value (LiteralString, LiteralReal, LiteralInteger, LiteralBoolean, or OpaqueExpression) of a Property or Port.

tools.name: cameo_set_property_aggregation
tools.description: Set aggregation (none, shared, composite) on an Association end or Property.

tools.name: cameo_set_specification
tools.description: Set structured fields of an element's Specification dialog that are not exposed by set_property_* tools.

tools.name: cameo_get_specification
tools.description: Read raw specification features and properties of an element in structured JSON form.

tools.name: cameo_find_usages
tools.description: Search where an element is used or referenced throughout the project.

tools.name: cameo_find_by_name
tools.description: Quick fuzzy or exact name search across the open project via Finder.byNameAllRecursively().

tools.name: cameo_clone_element
tools.description: Deep copy an element and its subtree under a new parent via CopyPasting.copyPasteElement.

tools.name: cameo_convert_element_type
tools.description: Refactor/convert an element to a compatible metaclass or stereotyped element via Refactoring.Converting.

tools.name: cameo_batch_modify_elements
tools.description: Modify names, documentation, tagged values, or parent owners across multiple elements in one atomic transaction.

tools.name: cameo_get_relationships
tools.description: Query incoming and outgoing relationships for an element with optional type and direction filters. [ajhcs/cameo-mcp-bridge Parity]

tools.name: cameo_get_transition_triggers
tools.description: Read explicit trigger, guard constraint, and effect behavior semantics for one state transition. [ajhcs/cameo-mcp-bridge Parity]

tools.name: cameo_set_transition_trigger
tools.description: Create or replace a SignalEvent, ChangeEvent, TimeEvent, or CallEvent trigger and guard on a transition. [ajhcs/cameo-mcp-bridge Parity]

tools.name: cameo_get_state_behaviors
tools.description: Read structured entry, doActivity, and exit Behavior payloads on a State element. [ajhcs/cameo-mcp-bridge Parity]

tools.name: cameo_set_state_behaviors
tools.description: Create or replace structured entry, doActivity, and exit OpaqueBehavior/Activity payloads on a State. [ajhcs/cameo-mcp-bridge Parity]

tools.name: cameo_set_usecase_subject
tools.description: Set or clear the UML subject Classifier list for a UseCase element. [ajhcs/cameo-mcp-bridge Parity]

tools.name: cameo_clone_elements_with_views
tools.description: Clone a collection of model elements and diagram symbols together via `CopyPasting.copyPasteElements(objects, dataParent, viewParent, withNewData, increaseNames)`. [Retroactive OpenAPI Discovery]

tools.name: cameo_copy_paste_symbol_style
tools.description: Copy visual styling from a source presentation element onto target symbols via `CopyPasting.copyPasteSymbolsStyle(source, targets)`. [Retroactive OpenAPI Discovery]

tools.name: cameo_refactor_convert_element
tools.description: Convert an element to another metaclass/type while preserving relationships and IDs via `Refactoring.Converting.convert(element, ConvertElementInfo)`. [Retroactive OpenAPI Discovery]

tools.name: cameo_refactor_replace_element
tools.description: Replace all references and usages of one element with another via `Refactoring.Replacing.replace(elementToReplace, replacement, rules)`. [Retroactive OpenAPI Discovery]

tools.name: cameo_refactor_reverse_relationship
tools.description: Reverse the source/target direction of a directed relationship or flow via `Refactoring.ReverseRelationship.reverse(relationship)`. [Retroactive OpenAPI Discovery]

tools.name: cameo_refactor_extract_model_fragment
tools.description: Extract selected elements/nodes into a new reusable element or sub-activity/sub-machine via `Refactoring.Extracting`. [Retroactive OpenAPI Discovery]

tools.name: cameo_create_new_project
tools.description: Create a new blank Cameo project via `ProjectsManager.createProject()` and optionally apply the SysML profile. [Retroactive OpenAPI Discovery]

tools.name: cameo_open_project_file
tools.description: Open a local `.mdzip` or `.xml` project file via `ProjectDescriptorsFactory.createProjectDescriptor(URI)` and `ProjectsManager.loadProject`. [Retroactive OpenAPI Discovery]

tools.name: cameo_close_project
tools.description: Close an open project cleanly via `ProjectsManager.closeProject(project)`. [Retroactive OpenAPI Discovery]

tools.name: cameo_save_project_as
tools.description: Save or export the active project to a new `.mdzip` file location via `ProjectsManager.saveProject(descriptor, silent)`. [Retroactive OpenAPI Discovery]

tools.name: cameo_list_attached_modules
tools.description: List all attached modules/usages (`.mdzip` libraries and profiles), versions, and shared packages via `ProjectUtilities.getAttachedProjects(project)`. [Retroactive OpenAPI Discovery]

tools.name: cameo_find_shared_packages
tools.description: Return all shared and re-shared packages across the primary project and attached modules via `ProjectUtilities.getSharedPackagesIncludingResharedRecursively`. [Retroactive OpenAPI Discovery]

tools.name: cameo_list_diagrams
tools.description: List all diagrams in the open project or under a specific package scope.

tools.name: cameo_open_diagram
tools.description: Open a diagram in Cameo's main workspace tab via DiagramPresentationElement.open().

tools.name: cameo_close_diagram
tools.description: Close an open diagram tab in Cameo.

tools.name: cameo_get_diagram_contents
tools.description: Retrieve the structure, symbols, positions, dimensions, and path lines of a diagram.

tools.name: cameo_create_diagram
tools.description: Create a new diagram of a specified type (BDD, IBD, Requirement Diagram, StateMachine, Activity, Sequence, UseCase, Package, Parametric Diagram, RelationMap, Content Diagram).

tools.name: cameo_delete_diagram
tools.description: Delete a diagram element and its layout representations.

tools.name: cameo_export_diagram
tools.description: Render a diagram to PNG, SVG, EMF, or JPG image file on disk via ImageExporter.export.

tools.name: cameo_get_diagram_image_base64
tools.description: Render a diagram to base64 image payload directly for inline vision analysis (alias: cameo_get_diagram_image).

tools.name: cameo_add_symbol_to_diagram
tools.description: Display a model element as a new symbol on a diagram at specified (x, y) coordinates (alias: cameo_add_to_diagram).

tools.name: cameo_add_symbols_to_diagram
tools.description: Bulk-populate multiple model elements onto a diagram in a single transaction.

tools.name: cameo_remove_symbol_from_diagram
tools.description: Remove a symbol presentation from a diagram without deleting the underlying model element (alias: cameo_delete_shapes).

tools.name: cameo_layout_diagram
tools.description: Apply automatic layout algorithms (hierarchical, orthogonal, tree, organic, SysML2) to a diagram (alias: cameo_auto_layout).

tools.name: cameo_set_symbol_bounds
tools.description: Resize or reposition a diagram symbol presentation via reshapeShapeElement (alias: cameo_move_shapes).

tools.name: cameo_set_symbol_style
tools.description: Modify color, font, fill, line style, or display properties of a diagram symbol (alias: cameo_set_shape_properties).

tools.name: cameo_add_path_to_diagram
tools.description: Display a relationship as a line connector (path symbol) between two diagram symbols (alias: cameo_add_diagram_paths).

tools.name: cameo_remove_path_from_diagram
tools.description: Remove a path presentation line from a diagram.

tools.name: cameo_reroute_path
tools.description: Adjust path connector routing points, endpoints, or path style (alias: cameo_route_paths).

tools.name: cameo_get_symbol_properties
tools.description: Read presentation-level visual properties of a symbol (alias: cameo_get_shape_properties).

tools.name: cameo_set_diagram_grid
tools.description: Toggle or set grid spacing and snap-to-grid settings on a diagram.

tools.name: cameo_zoom_diagram
tools.description: Adjust zoom scale factor or fit-to-window on an active diagram.

tools.name: cameo_center_symbol
tools.description: Scroll and center the diagram view on a specific symbol or element.

tools.name: cameo_select_diagram_symbols
tools.description: Highlight and select specific symbols in the open diagram tab.

tools.name: cameo_clear_diagram_selection
tools.description: Deselect all active symbol selections on the open diagram.

tools.name: cameo_create_shape_on_diagram
tools.description: Add non-model shape elements (rectangles, text boxes, notes, separator lines, images) to a diagram.

tools.name: cameo_create_note_anchor
tools.description: Connect a Comment/Note box symbol to a target symbol with an anchor line via PresentationElementsManager.connectNote.

tools.name: cameo_get_diagram_legend
tools.description: Read or inspect applied legend elements and legend items on a diagram.

tools.name: cameo_apply_diagram_legend
tools.description: Apply a Legend and its dynamic color-coding/adornment rules to a diagram.

tools.name: cameo_group_symbols
tools.description: Group multiple diagram symbols into a visual group container.

tools.name: cameo_ungroup_symbols
tools.description: Ungroup a container symbol group on a diagram.

tools.name: cameo_order_symbols
tools.description: Change z-order depth (bringToFront, sendToBack, bringForward, sendBackward) of symbols on a diagram.

tools.name: cameo_align_symbols
tools.description: Align selected diagram symbols horizontally, vertically, or distribute evenly.

tools.name: cameo_resize_symbols_to_fit
tools.description: Auto-fit symbol sizes to fit their internal text or compartment contents.

tools.name: cameo_toggle_compartment_visibility
tools.description: Show or hide compartments (properties, operations, ports, constraints, tagged values, allocations) on a symbol (alias: cameo_set_shape_compartments).

tools.name: cameo_nest_symbol
tools.description: Nest a symbol visually inside a parent container symbol on a diagram (alias: cameo_reparent_shapes).

tools.name: cameo_get_diagram_frame
tools.description: Read or update the diagram frame boundaries and header properties.

tools.name: cameo_list_diagram_types
tools.description: List validated diagram request tokens, aliases, and native Cameo DiagramTypeConstants. [ajhcs/cameo-mcp-bridge Parity]

tools.name: cameo_add_to_diagram
tools.description: Place a model element on a diagram canvas via PresentationElementsManager.createShapeElement and return its presentationId. [ajhcs/cameo-mcp-bridge Parity]

tools.name: cameo_get_diagram_image
tools.description: Export a diagram image as base64 PNG/JPEG with optional metadata-only, resize, and transcode controls. [ajhcs/cameo-mcp-bridge Parity]

tools.name: cameo_auto_layout
tools.description: Apply Cameo's built-in diagram auto-layout via DiagramPresentationElement.layout. [ajhcs/cameo-mcp-bridge Parity]

tools.name: cameo_list_diagram_shapes
tools.description: List diagram shapes recursively with paging, filtering, bounds, summary counts, and presentation IDs. [ajhcs/cameo-mcp-bridge Parity]

tools.name: cameo_get_shape_properties
tools.description: Read the current display PropertyManager properties of one diagram shape. [ajhcs/cameo-mcp-bridge Parity]

tools.name: cameo_move_shapes
tools.description: Reposition and resize shapes on a diagram via PresentationElementsManager.reshapeShapeElement with per-item results. [ajhcs/cameo-mcp-bridge Parity]

tools.name: cameo_delete_shapes
tools.description: Remove shapes from a diagram via PresentationElementsManager.deletePresentationElement (model elements preserved). [ajhcs/cameo-mcp-bridge Parity]

tools.name: cameo_add_diagram_paths
tools.description: Draw relationship paths between shapes on a diagram via PresentationElementsManager.createPathElement. [ajhcs/cameo-mcp-bridge Parity]

tools.name: cameo_set_shape_properties
tools.description: Set display properties (colors, fonts, compartment visibility) via cloned PropertyManager with receipts. [ajhcs/cameo-mcp-bridge Parity]

tools.name: cameo_set_shape_compartments
tools.description: Apply normalized compartment visibility controls to one shape via CompartmentManager. [ajhcs/cameo-mcp-bridge Parity]

tools.name: cameo_set_transition_label_presentation
tools.description: Apply a high-level state-transition label preset (show trigger, guard, effect) on a State Machine diagram. [ajhcs/cameo-mcp-bridge Parity]

tools.name: cameo_set_item_flow_label_presentation
tools.description: Apply a high-level item-flow/information-flow label preset for SysML IBD cleanup. [ajhcs/cameo-mcp-bridge Parity]

tools.name: cameo_set_allocation_compartment_presentation
tools.description: Apply a high-level allocation/full-port compartment presentation preset for SysML BDD/IBD cleanup. [ajhcs/cameo-mcp-bridge Parity]

tools.name: cameo_repair_hidden_labels
tools.description: Auto-show hidden path and port labels using diagram-type-aware native repair defaults. [ajhcs/cameo-mcp-bridge Parity]

tools.name: cameo_repair_label_positions
tools.description: Reset overlapping path labels via PresentationElementsManager.resetLabelPositions with dry-run receipts. [ajhcs/cameo-mcp-bridge Parity]

tools.name: cameo_repair_conveyed_item_labels
tools.description: Force conveyed-item/item-flow labels visible on eligible connector/flow paths. [ajhcs/cameo-mcp-bridge Parity]

tools.name: cameo_normalize_compartment_presets
tools.description: Normalize compartment and full-port visibility across all shapes on a diagram by diagram type. [ajhcs/cameo-mcp-bridge Parity]

tools.name: cameo_prune_diagram_presentations
tools.description: Remove unwanted auto-displayed symbols while preserving caller-requested presentation IDs. [ajhcs/cameo-mcp-bridge Parity]

tools.name: cameo_prune_path_decorations
tools.description: Remove cluttered child path decorations such as association end role/multiplicity labels. [ajhcs/cameo-mcp-bridge Parity]

tools.name: cameo_reparent_shapes
tools.description: Move existing presentation elements under new container shapes via PresentationElementsManager.movePresentationElement. [ajhcs/cameo-mcp-bridge Parity]

tools.name: cameo_route_paths
tools.description: Update path breakpoints, client/supplier connection points, and label reset behavior via changePathPoints. [ajhcs/cameo-mcp-bridge Parity]

tools.name: cameo_rename_diagram
tools.description: Rename a Diagram element and update its DiagramPresentationElement header. [Retroactive OpenAPI Discovery]

tools.name: cameo_open_close_diagram_tab
tools.description: Open, focus, or close a diagram tab in Cameo's main GUI via `DiagramPresentationElement.open()` / `ProjectDiagramWindowsManager`. [Retroactive OpenAPI Discovery]

tools.name: cameo_export_diagram_to_file
tools.description: Export a diagram directly to disk as PNG, SVG, EMF, JPEG, or PDF via `ImageExporter.export(dpe, format, file)` without base64 token overhead. [Retroactive OpenAPI Discovery]

tools.name: cameo_create_sequence_message
tools.description: Create a positioned Sequence Diagram message (synchCall, asynchCall, asynchSignal, reply, createMessage, deleteMessage, or recursive self-message) with explicit `insertAfter` and `verticalGap` via `PresentationElementsManager.createSequenceMessage`. [Retroactive OpenAPI Discovery]

tools.name: cameo_create_lost_or_found_message
tools.description: Create a Lost or Found sequence message symbol on a lifeline via `PresentationElementsManager.createLostMessage` / `createFoundMessage`. [Retroactive OpenAPI Discovery]

tools.name: cameo_create_path_to_self
tools.description: Create a self-transition or self-relationship shape element when client == supplier via `PresentationElementsManager.createPathToSelfShapeElement`. [Retroactive OpenAPI Discovery]

tools.name: cameo_create_swimlane
tools.description: Create horizontal and vertical ActivityPartition swimlanes on an Activity diagram via `PresentationElementsManager.createSwimlane`. [Retroactive OpenAPI Discovery]

tools.name: cameo_create_deep_part_shape
tools.description: Create a nested IBD PartView symbol with explicit `nestedPath` property chain (dot-notation part hierarchy) via `PresentationElementsManager.createPartShape`. [Retroactive OpenAPI Discovery]

tools.name: cameo_create_note_or_textbox
tools.description: Create a Note, TextBox, Separator, or ImageShape on a diagram and optionally anchor it to a target symbol via `createNote` / `connectNote` / `setText`. [Retroactive OpenAPI Discovery]

tools.name: cameo_list_tables
tools.description: List all Generic Tables, Requirements Tables, or Custom Tables in the project (alias: cameo_list_generic_tables).

tools.name: cameo_get_table_contents
tools.description: Retrieve column definitions, row elements, and cell values from a table (alias: cameo_get_generic_table).

tools.name: cameo_create_table
tools.description: Create a new Generic Table or Requirements Table artifact under an owner package (alias: cameo_create_generic_table).

tools.name: cameo_add_table_row
tools.description: Add a model element as a row in a Generic Table via GenericTableManager.

tools.name: cameo_remove_table_row
tools.description: Remove an element row from a Generic Table.

tools.name: cameo_set_table_columns
tools.description: Configure the displayed columns/properties of a Generic Table.

tools.name: cameo_export_table
tools.description: Export Generic Table data to CSV, Excel (XLSX), or JSON.

tools.name: cameo_list_matrices
tools.description: List all Dependency Matrices or SysML Allocation/Satisfy/Derive/Refine Matrices in the project.

tools.name: cameo_get_matrix_contents
tools.description: Retrieve row elements, column elements, and cell relation intersections from a matrix (alias: cameo_get_matrix).

tools.name: cameo_create_matrix
tools.description: Create a new Dependency/SysML Matrix with row and column scopes and types.

tools.name: cameo_export_matrix
tools.description: Export Dependency Matrix data to CSV or Excel.

tools.name: cameo_list_relation_maps
tools.description: List Relation Map diagrams in the project.

tools.name: cameo_get_relation_map_contents
tools.description: Read tree/graph expansion nodes and persisted GraphSettings from a Relation Map (alias: cameo_get_relation_map).

tools.name: cameo_create_relation_map
tools.description: Create a new Relation Map with specified context element, depth, and relation criteria.

tools.name: cameo_generate_report
tools.description: Trigger Cameo Report Wizard to generate documents (Word DOCX, PDF, HTML, PPTX) using installed templates.

tools.name: cameo_list_report_templates
tools.description: List available Report Wizard templates via TemplateHelper.listTemplates().

tools.name: cameo_export_model_xml
tools.description: Export package or model to XMI / Eclipse UML2 XML format (`com.nomagic.magicdraw.emfuml2xmi`).

tools.name: cameo_import_model_xml
tools.description: Import model structures from external UML/SysML XMI files.

tools.name: cameo_list_matrix_kinds
tools.description: List validated native matrix kinds (refine, derive, satisfy, allocation, dependency), aliases, and example type domains. [ajhcs/cameo-mcp-bridge Parity]

tools.name: cameo_get_matrix
tools.description: Read one supported native matrix with rows, columns, and populated cells. [ajhcs/cameo-mcp-bridge Parity]

tools.name: cameo_list_generic_tables
tools.description: List native Generic Table artifacts in the project. [ajhcs/cameo-mcp-bridge Parity]

tools.name: cameo_get_generic_table
tools.description: Read one Generic Table with row, column, and cell data via GenericTableManager. [ajhcs/cameo-mcp-bridge Parity]
